notes: Random group tables (0..12 records of 0xca bytes at 0x1d0000 with random active, type, member, kind, side and reference fields), aid priorities, filter modes 0..6, start priority and current object, and in 30% of the cases with groups a step request (next, previous) from a valid start group. Reference blocks have small cells and offsets; objects and scene nodes sit near reference points or each other so that distances straddle 3,200,000 and 0x271000; in 20% they all sit in one tight cluster with situation 1 groups of equal priority, so that the fixed distances of situation 1 tie. 0x7489c and 0x8ffe8 log AX and return per-case object and node pointers (0x7489c sometimes 0); 0x33b4 logs AX and stores a per-case object (often the current one) in 0x197061; 0x9c960 returns random 32-bit values. 0x3aa8, abs and max3 run as originals.
